carpet.color: A localized region has an abnormal colour or tone.
carpet.cut: A sharp incision or sliced region interrupts the texture.
carpet.hole: Material is missing in a compact hole-like region.
carpet.metal_contamination: A metallic foreign object lies on the surface.
carpet.thread: A foreign thread lies across the regular texture.

grid.bent: The regular grid lines are locally warped or displaced.
grid.broken: Part of the repeating grid is interrupted or missing.
grid.glue: A localized glue deposit changes the surface appearance.
grid.metal_contamination: A metallic foreign object lies on the surface.
grid.thread: A foreign thread lies across the regular texture.

leather.color: A localized region has an abnormal colour or tone.
leather.cut: A sharp incision or sliced region interrupts the texture.
leather.fold: The surface is creased or folded out of its normal plane.
leather.glue: A localized glue deposit changes the surface appearance.
leather.poke: A small puncture-like indentation or opening is visible.

tile.crack: A narrow fracture-like line crosses the material surface.
tile.glue_strip: An elongated strip of adhesive lies on the tile.
tile.gray_stroke: A grey linear mark appears across the tile.
tile.oil: An oily region changes colour or reflectance.
tile.rough: A localized patch is visibly rougher than normal.

wood.color: A localized region has an abnormal colour or tone.
wood.combined: More than one defect mechanism appears in the same image.
wood.hole: Material is missing in a compact hole-like region.
wood.liquid: A liquid stain changes colour or reflectance locally.
wood.scratch: A thin elongated abrasion crosses the surface.
